title: Ning Li and Smalley took $400,000 in Army Research Lab money and delivered nothing

tellings.quote: and and they made off with $400,000 in army research lab money and didn't produce a producible for it. They didn't deliver anything for that money.

related.note: Both are about the defense money Li and Smalley's company received. This telling says Li then went silent into secret work; Davis says they took the money and delivered nothing.

plain: Two researchers at the University of Alabama in Huntsville, Ning Li and Larry Smalley, took $400,000 from the Army Research Lab and delivered nothing for it. That is what Eric W. Davis says on the show, a scientist presented as having worked with the Pentagon: they "made off with" the money and "didn't deliver anything," and he also names a colleague, Travis Taylor. If true, a government-funded research claim came to nothing.
